_comment: Expected PP-406 fill for examples/case.example.json. Subtotal fields (gross_value_*, calc_gross_*) are computed by formulas.yaml — the pipeline should recompute them from the slot rows, not ask the LLM to add them up.
_pipeline_note: Slot rows (real_prop_*, tang_prop_*, int_prop_*) come from the LLM mapping narrative_facts.real_property[i] → real_prop_<i+1>_{desc,value,enc}.
Computed fields (gross_value_*, calc_gross_*) are derived from formulas.yaml after the LLM completes the slot rows. Validator's recompute_from_dependencies will flag any drift.
Empty slot rows (real_prop_3..6, tang_prop_12..17, int_prop_23..25) are left null — the LLM should NOT pad them with placeholder values.
Currency values are formatted as plain numerics here; the form fill pipeline formats them with $ and commas at write time (currency-purity rule from fill_form prompts).
